premises.text: Small businesses need branding but face either expensive crowdsourced design or low-quality DIY
premises.evidence_span: Either pay hundreds and thousands of dollars for online crowdsource services, or if you're like most businesses who can't afford that, you end up doing something on your own and compromise for really low quality branding

premises.text: Taylor is a learning system that applies design rules to study a business and generate fresh, template-free brand designs
premises.evidence_span: Taylor is a learning system that turns your computer into a graphic designer

premises.text: Customers pay only when thrilled; for about $50 they get logo, business card, letterhead, and brand book
premises.evidence_span: no money exchanges hands until you're completely thrilled with your new design

premises.text: Taylor continues as an ongoing service designing offline and online assets as the company grows
premises.evidence_span: Taylor is not just a design tool. It's a service, and it's going to walk with your company and design everything it can possibly need

premises.text: As a learning system, Taylor can surface brand and trend insights from the brands it designs
premises.evidence_span: using the thousands of brands it actually designs, it can actually understand brand insights, and trend insights, and give that to you

value.text: Make great, affordable branding accessible to small businesses
value.evidence_span: put an in-house designer in every business across the world for just 50 bucks

causal_links.evidence_span: design the perfect brand for it
they can look as good as any Fortune 500 company with Taylor
